classification_note: not_expressible means no established executable construction in this replay. gap_kind distinguishes evidenced model/data gaps from construction_pending decisions; pending constructions do not claim the underlying liability model is absent.
years_note: Calendar year starting the OBR fiscal year is the proxy. FY before 2023-24 stays accounted but is not simulated. Detailed pinned-engine/data support is recorded in docs/uk_replay/YEARS.md.

bundle.registry_rule: The identity of the certified populace-uk artifact a UK compute run must execute against. Committed so verification is OFFLINE and byte-exact: a run checks the artifact it was handed against this digest before constructing a simulation, rather than trusting a filename or a path.
bundle.provenance: Read from the release's own release_manifest.json in policyengine/populace-uk-private on 2026-09-07, and independently confirmed by downloading the artifact at that revision and hashing it.
bundle.why_this_bundle: It is the bundle the 14 existing UK results were computed against (run_id campaign-20260802-reckoner-t2, engine_version 2.89.2 in pe_results). A counterpart computed on a different bundle is not comparable to them.
bundle.engine_constraint_note: The bundle DECLARES policyengine-uk ==2.89.2. That is not this repo's preference; it is the data's own compatibility statement. Computing at a newer engine needs a NEW certified bundle, not a relaxed check — see #126.

publication.units_note: All figures in GBP million; Treasury costings rounded to nearest GBP 5m (GBP 1m since Budget 2018)

source.source_row_identity: 1-based line in uncompressed claims_path plus sha256 of the verbatim UTF-8 row
source.harvest_note: Spending rows use proposed_metric=exchequer_impact; tax rows use metric=revenue_change. Both signs are positive_gain_to_exchequer. Raw rows and original values are retained in the checked-in harvest; registries contain traceable normalized pointers.

orientation: positive means gain to the Exchequer; reversal effect = -(literal reversal - certified baseline)

accounting.identity: rows_in = rows_classified; net GBP in = net GBP classified; absolute GBP in = absolute GBP classified (also within each FY)
accounting.sign_convention: positive means a gain to the Exchequer
accounting.amount_basis: All harvested GBP cells across all source heads and costing years, including zeros; this is not a one-year Budget total.
